name: Regular Isosurface Extraction
definition: Computes the zero-isovalue intersection curve on a cube by finding edge crossings, grouping them by face, sorting them, and connecting adjacent pairs with line segments.
summary: Regular Isosurface Extraction computes zero-isovalue intersections by identifying edge crossings, grouping them by face, and connecting adjacent pairs with line segments without using a precomputed lookup table.
